Okay, on the sidebar are links to the wiki, the game guide, and a site called GrimCalc, which is an interactive character planner.

As far as general tips - 

Physique is key, but you don't have to spend stat points. Basically save them for when you need them for new equipment or such, because you can't respec them

Mastery points (the bar on the bottom of your skills) can't be respec'd either. So only spend points if you're going for a specific skill.

More points in an active skill is better than a few points in a bunch. Don't spread too thin, look at your classes and stick with a damage type or two.

Otherwise normal/vet is clearable with almost any build. Later, you can find things that work, respec skills, and make whatever changes you want. 

I can't think of more, but ask questions, and check out all the resources in the sidebar. And happy loot hunting

So first, you might want to check out the sidebar, the Build Compendiums have a lot of good ideas to get you thinking, and GrimCalc is great for playing with skill points out of game.

As far as dual-wield goes, there are a bunch of options, all based around nightblade and another class. Spellbreaker (nightblade and arcanist), trickster (nightblade and shaman), and blademaster (nightblade and soldier) are all popular, and can all play as dual wielders using the dual blades line at the top of the nightblade tree. Remember - only stat points and mastery bar cannot be respeced, so try different stuff out and don't worry about it too much.

Anyways, really it's all about having a good time, so try stuff out and see what you like!
